Name: Ran's Spouse Garden
Author: ranfuu
Description:
Originally made for my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2969]Harvest Goddess[/url] mod; I made new versions where you can grow actual crops!

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
- 4 styles available:
Default1 - Empty garden
Default2 - Has water source in the corner
Foliage1 - Has plants on the wall
Foliage2 - Has plants on the wall and a water source

[b]HOW TO USE:
[/b]- Open content.json
- Replace the following with the name of your spouse:
[i]"name": "Shane",[/i]
- Replace the following with style of room you want to use:
[i]"file": "Default1.tmx",[/i]

[b]NOTES:[/b]
- Only works when you're married
- Uses a separate tilesheet that can be edited with an image editor like photoshop to recolour or further personalize your garden

[b]REQUIREMENTS:
[/b]- SMAPI
- PyTK
- TMXLoader

[b]INSTALL:
[/b]- Install the latest version of the required mods
- Download and unzip file
- Place in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
- Run game with SMAPI

[b]UNINSTALL:
[/b]- Simply remove from mods folder

[b]CREDIT:
[/b]-[url=http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/] http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]Platonymous for the spouse room template[/url]

Personal edits ok
Please do not reupload/redistribute
